mentions.name: actualia
mentions.description: This app delivers customized and verifiable news summaries. It summarizes RSS feeds and other sources filtered by the user's interests, with a strong emphasis on user relevance, routine integration, and UX. It is currently in closed beta, aiming for a Q3 launch.
